name: Logo Cluster Pop-in
easing: tiles: spring pop {12,140,0.7} staggered 6f from f4; dim others EASE-linear f54-66
bestFor: A group of real logos ('other closed-tier models' -> ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok...), then one highlighted.
keyframeTable: rest: highlighted tile orange, others at 45%
script: Tiles (240x200) spring in one by one.
Tile content = real logo from assets/logos/<file> (placeholder circle + initial if file missing).
Then all but the highlighted tile dim and the highlighted tile turns orange.

params.files: array of filenames in assets/logos/ (same order)

colorRules: Highlighted tile orange only. Logos keep native colors.
status: rendered (logo/screenshot slots show labelled placeholders until assets are fetched)
